# Field boundaries for Cambodia and Vietnam (AI4SmallFarms) with splits

Cambodia/Vietnam (AI4SF) with splits field boundaries (2021) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from DATA Archiving and Networked Services (DANS). License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ai4sf_ml/latest/ai4sf_ml.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ai4sf_ml/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:32648; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: group, metrics:area, admin:country_code, split, geometry, id, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ai4sf_ml/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ai4sf_ml/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ai4sf_ml/collection.json
